lastCompletedStory.title: Project cycle markers, merge-watch, sidecar-stalled, and container-preflight event into the status read-model

nextStoryContext: US-002 extended StatusReport (src/commands/status.ts) with 9 new optional fields, all populated in a single new helper `projectCycleState(cwd): CycleStateProjection` (a Pick<StatusReport, ...> over just these fields) called once from buildStatusReport via `Object.assign(report, projectCycleState(cwd))`: shipStalled (readShipStalledMarker/.cam-ship-stalled.json), planEscalated (readPlanEscalatedMarker/.cam-plan-escalated.json), planPreflightFailed (readPlanPreflightFailedMarker/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json), implementBlocked (readImplementBlockedMarker/.cam-implement-blocked.json), postMergeStalled (readPostMergeStalledMarker/.cam-post-merge-stalled.json), gate (readGateFileLenient/.cam-gate.json), mergeWatch ({prNumber, pollCount (defaults 0), lastPolledAt?} via readMergeWatchState/.cam-merge-watch.json), sidecarStalled (readSidecarStalledMarker/.cam-sidecar-stalled.json), and containerPreflight ({ready, reason?, ts} -- the LAST kind:'container-preflight' line from .claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl, via a new local readLastContainerPreflightEvent helper that parses each JSONL line inside its own try/catch so one malformed line never stops the scan). All reads are via each marker's existing lenient never-throw reader; zero writes anywhere in the new code (proven by an mtimeMs-diff test suite). The projection fan-out was extracted into its own function specifically because inlining it into buildStatusReport tripped Biome's noExcessiveLinesPerFunction (max 80) gate -- see the new patterns.md bullet for the general lesson (any read-model fan-out over 4+ existing lenient readers should be extracted up front). This story did NOT wire any of these new StatusReport fields into runStatus's stdout rendering (the print path) -- printing them is a natural follow-up but was out of scope for this story's acceptance criteria, which only covered buildStatusReport's projection. src/commands/status.ts's file-size-budget.json ceiling was raised 642->850 (a large jump: 9 new optional StatusReport fields + their doc comments + the projectCycleState helper + the event-log reader helper, all additive, no line removed).
